manual.intro: Add these records in your registrar’s DNS zone. We check them every 10 seconds and tell you when it works.

help.txt: Why a TXT record? It proves the domain is yours, so nobody else can point it at their server.
help.propagation: Changes can take from a minute to a few hours to reach everyone. We keep checking; you don’t need to stay here.
help.apex: Apex domains (yourname.net without “play.”) need an ALIAS/ANAME record; not every registrar has one. A subdomain always works.

ovh.name: OVHcloud
ovh.steps:
Web Cloud › Domain names › your domain › DNS zone.
Click “Add an entry” and pick the type (CNAME, SRV, A or TXT).
Sub-domain = the Name below (leave empty for the domain itself), Target = the Value.
Repeat for each record, then confirm. OVH applies changes within minutes.

gandi.name: Gandi
gandi.steps:
Domain › your domain › DNS records.
Click “Add record”, choose the type.
Name = the Name below, Value = the Value (keep the final dot for CNAME/SRV targets).
Save each record.

namecheap.name: Namecheap
namecheap.steps:
Domain List › Manage › Advanced DNS.
Under Host records, “Add new record”.
Host = the Name below (@ for the domain itself), Value/Target = the Value.
Click the green tick to save each one.

godaddy.name: GoDaddy
godaddy.steps:
My Products › your domain › DNS › Manage DNS.
Click “Add new record”, pick the type.
Name = the Name below (@ for the domain itself), Value = the Value.
For SRV, fill Service _minecraft, Protocol _tcp, then priority, weight and port. Save.

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.steps:
Select your site › DNS › Records › Add record.
Pick the type, Name = the Name below, Target/Content = the Value.
Set Proxy status to “DNS only” (grey cloud): the game traffic cannot go through Cloudflare’s proxy.
Save each record.

ionos.name: IONOS
ionos.steps:
Domains & SSL › your domain › DNS.
Click “Add record” and pick the type.
Host name = the Name below, Points to / Value = the Value.
Save; IONOS may ask to confirm replacing a default record.

hostinger.name: Hostinger
hostinger.steps:
Domains › your domain › DNS / Nameservers.
Under “Manage DNS records”, choose the type.
Name = the Name below, Points to / Value = the Value, TTL as shown.
Click “Add record” for each one.

porkbun.name: Porkbun (by hand)
porkbun.steps:
Domain Management › your domain › DNS.
Pick the type, Host = the Name below (empty for the domain itself), Answer = the Value.
Click “Add” for each record.
Tip: the Connect Porkbun path does all of this for you.

generic.name: Other registrar
generic.steps:
Open your domain’s DNS zone (sometimes called DNS records or Zone editor).
Add each record below with the same type, name and value.
If your registrar asks for the full name, add your domain after the Name.
Save, then come back: we check automatically.
